title: Unnerving mallworld experience lately
content: My mallworld is generally mundane and just feels a little more structured then normal dreams and where I am generally inside and just doing something like going back and forth on like repeat in some area without ever feeling like it is repetitive even though it is. Lately… I’ve been having less mundane experiences, and just outside of my mall world on a typical city block in my city that’s generally residential. I find myself in a garden level apartment (so the door is street level, but you walk downstairs (not a basement feel), but lately I get a sense that I’m in the wrong apartment in the wrong building. I’ll go outside the front door and realize I went into a door that felt familiar but wasn’t actually where my apartment door is. I’ll end up back downstairs in the garden level apartment but feeling uneasy, like I need to be leaving and searching for the real apartment. It takes place on one block but feels like an endless amount of places that seem almost familiar but aren’t. Last night I woke feeling anxious about needing to get back to sleep to continue looking for my correct apartment because it feels like I’m close..just not there. Also, the outside of the apartment will always seem ALMOST right. Like the front door will seem correct but the mailbox will be on the side of the door and not build into the door itself… or it will feel like someone is going to come home and find that I’m in their apartment accidentally. It was very unnerving .
